name: Quarry Village
summary: Quarry Village is an upscale outdoor lifestyle center in San Antonio's prestigious Alamo Heights neighborhood, featuring boutique shopping, farm-to-table dining, and premium lifestyle services. This vibrant destination combines eclectic retailers, innovative restaurants with outdoor patios, and luxury amenities including spa and salon services, creating an elevated shopping and dining experience.
demographics: Quarry Village attracts an affluent, educated demographic from the Alamo Heights area and surrounding upscale San Antonio neighborhoods, with visitors typically in the 30-65 age range and above-average household incomes. The trade area serves professionals, families, and empty nesters who value quality dining experiences, boutique shopping, and premium services. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for experiential retail, with visitors often combining dining at farm-to-table restaurants with boutique browsing and personal services like spa treatments and salon visits, creating extended dwell times and repeat visits.
description: Quarry Village is a premier outdoor lifestyle center located in the heart of Alamo Heights at 260 East Basse Road in San Antonio, Texas. This upscale shopping destination seamlessly blends boutique shopping, exquisite dining, and luxury living into a vibrant community experience. The center features eclectic boutiques offering designer shoes and one-of-a-kind fashion pieces, alongside classic brands that cater to discerning shoppers seeking to showcase their personal style. Dining options include innovative farm-to-table restaurants with shady outdoor patios, inviting wine lounges, cozy cafés, and fresh gourmet delis that create memorable culinary experiences. Beyond shopping and dining, Quarry Village offers an elevated lifestyle with indulgent spa services, beauty salons, and wellness amenities, while the adjacent Artessa luxury apartments provide residents with the unique opportunity to live steps away from this dynamic retail and dining hub. Professionally managed by CBRE, Quarry Village has earned a 4.5-star rating from over 2,000 reviews, establishing itself as a beloved destination where the community comes together to shop, dine, and play.
